output.summary: A mustard plant of unstated native origin, it has cultivars grown for leafy greens, swollen stems, roots and oilseeds. Its edible leaves, seeds and stems range from peppery greens to pickles and spicy brown mustard.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves, seeds and stems are edible; they are eaten raw, boiled, cooked or pickled, and the seeds provide brown mustard and mustard oil.
